old_problem: The source neither identifies the ACS-capable endpoint/upstream function and enabled control nor proves AMD errortype4 semantics; one tuple cannot cover every slot, and stale BERT can falsely satisfy PASS.
disposition_reason: PCIe ACS capability/control layout and CPER decoding are standard, but the vendor injection flag, required ACS locus/control and project fatal reset policy are not. Baseline OCP row66 preserves coverage but does not authorize this PCIe target or resolve errortype4. ED-03/13/16 prohibit guessing the stimulus, applicability or recovery. Pending/BLOCKED remains until an authoritative package and fresh-record contract exist.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row65, same-row AI/history2466, completed OCP companion row66 evidence and next pending row67.
Preserved every PCIe slot, ACS fatal stimulus, warm reset and fresh BERT/CPER requirements.
Distinguished ACS capability presence from the exact function and control state relevant to injection.
Required pre-event inventory and source-correlated CPER freshness rather than post-boot keyword matching.
No NIC installation, control change, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: PCIe ACS fatal reset with fresh source-correlated CPER
test_case.purpose: For every approved PCIe slot, inject one authoritative ACS-fatal condition at the exact ACS-capable hierarchy point and verify warm reset, one fresh correlated CPER/BERT record and complete NIC/link recovery.
required_package: Exact ACS capability/control locus and required bits
Decoded AER/DPC/SyncFlood/reset policy and fresh CPER field oracle
Independent OOB boot/reimage and NIC/link/configuration recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not run errortype4. Once approved, inventory prior BERT/CPER records and ACS controls, capture OOB baseline, target one signed path once, record reset/firmware/boot, decode the new PCIe CPER source/severity, then restore controls and prove NIC/link/system health before another slot.
test_case.expected_result: The intended ACS path produces the approved fatal event and immediate warm reset; exactly one new durable CPER/BERT record identifies that hierarchy and severity; the system boots within deadline and the NIC, driver and link recover with restored controls.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until flag, ACS locus/control and reset oracle are authoritative. lspci keyword presence, tool PASS, stale BERT, generic dmesg, wrong source, missing/unexpected reset, boot failure or persistent link loss fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/serial console.
Quiesce traffic and exclude boot/management-critical endpoints.
One mapped target once; abort on wrong source, missing reset, boot loop or stale/missing CPER.
No automatic retry/reset; preserve durable evidence.
expected_evidence: Pre-event BERT inventory and injection transcript
OOB reset/boot timeline plus fresh decoded CPER
test_case.recovery: Provide expected and anomalous reset branches, boot-loop/reimage escape, NIC/link recovery and exact ACS/AER/BIOS/HDT rollback. Execution remains blocked until approved.
